summaryDeep: Their raw, uncompromising instinct presses against how freely you present yourself and enter situations. Their refusal to soften can make your way of showing up feel judged as fake, and your polish can read to them as hiding. Neither is entirely wrong about the other, which is the uncomfortable part.
